title: Drafting wake gaps with outside-cone control
description: Draft fixture from BENCHMARKS.md 'Handling fixtures' (Draft row): equal stock cars on a 500 m straight with initial gaps of 4/5/10/20/21 m plus an outside-cone control. The 4 m and 21 m runs bracket the documented 5-20 m wake window from below and above, and the control run sits outside the +/-10 degree cone with more than 1.5 m lateral separation, so none of the three may become eligible. The 30 m/s entry speed is an authored initial value; BENCHMARKS specifies the gaps only. Drafting parameters are the GAME_DESIGN documented initial values; their perceptual effect is undetermined until M1 measurement and review.

expected_events.note: Eligibility requires the documented 0.7 s inside the wake window and cone.

2.0 m lateral separation exceeds the documented 1.5 m and leaves the +/-10 degree cone.
No run leaves the wake within the 500 m section; the 0.5 s fade is exercised by M1 motor tests rather than by this fixture.

comparison.purpose: Record drafting-on/off closing distance and overtaking opportunity at each gap, with the outside-cone control proving the eligibility rule. AI and players use identical drafting.
